name: Artaios

attributes.attribute: the Roman god he was equated with

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Artaios is a Continental Celtic god. Some writers spell his name Artaius. He is a bear god, kin to the goddess of wisdom. He was equated with the Roman Mercury by some Gaul peoples.

okr.objective: Record Artaios, a Continental bear god equated with Mercury.
